adoption_note: MIGRATED to native structured output 2026-07-19 (T8 phase 2). The 2026-07-18 probe left ONE blocker: text.format json_schema was probed WITHOUT the bot's web_search tool, so schema+grounding coexistence was unverified. The 2026-07-19 re-probe sent BOTH together (tools=[{'type':'web_search'}] AND text.format) and got status=completed with clean schema-valid JSON AND a real non-abstain vote (grounding fired under the schema). grokutil now attempts this shape first; the delimiter-tag request is retained only as the schema-parameter-rejection fallback.

quirks: Responses API structured output uses text={'format': {...}} (Responses shape), NOT chat-completions' response_format - full schema with minimum/maximum and additionalProperties accepted, strict mode.

COEXISTENCE VERIFIED 2026-07-19: text.format json_schema + the web_search grounding tool in the SAME request returned status=completed with valid JSON AND a real non-abstain vote (the 2026-07-18 probe abstained; the re-probe with grounding produced a live HOLD@0.55). This was the last blocker to adoption.

max_output_tokens is a SOFT cap on this API (observed exceeded on plain calls) - grokutil leaves it UNSET on analysis calls to avoid truncation; empty output maps to abstain(parse_failure), never a vote.
DELTA vs 2026-07-18: request now carries tools; response is a real HOLD@0.55 (not the earlier abstain=true) because grounding fires under the schema.
